dependencies.instrument: Aliens and Immigration Law, Cap.105, and regulations
dependencies.relationship: Gov.cy identifies Cap.105 as governing entry and residence of third-country family members of Cypriot citizens. The OLC index identifies a government-published Greek consolidation (GEN-N.72), but its recorded PDF route returns 404. Prefer that consolidation if a current working route is found; no full Gazette amendment chain is required. Law 4(I)/2025 is captured as enacted Greek text, and section 29 defers commencement until a Cabinet notice; a current consolidation may resolve that operative-status question.
dependencies.status: primary 2025 amendment artifact and bounded section-29 passage accepted; current government-published consolidated Cap.105 text is not captured and operative status of section 29 remains unresolved

dependencies.relationship: Primary text and amendment histories must establish the recourse period, omissions, jurisdiction, procedure and relief. CyLaw pages are secondary leads only. EDD 215/19 is one official immigration-removal appeal, not a substitute for the primary constitutional/procedural texts or EU-family case coverage. The official Greek 2025 amendment texts and rule-index entry are accepted within their stated scopes; the official appellate-decisions listing was directly reviewed 20 October 2026 as a discovery route only; full current primary text and the individual rule remain open.
dependencies.status: Official appellate-decisions discovery listing reviewed 20 October 2026; individual decisions, current procedural texts, rule 11/2025 text and legal-remedy coverage remain unresolved. Full amendment-history reconstruction is not required.
